digest.component_or_area: LLM failure reporting and operator messaging
propositions: Operator message for content-filter/guardrail blocks incorrectly says 'too large / malformed' when the actual cause is a content policy intervention
message_for() needs to accept optional finish_reason parameter and return a distinct message when resolution_class is CHANGE_INPUT and finish_reason is 'content_filter'
finish_reason must be threaded through three call sites: LLM commands, close_precheck, and diagnostic coverage
CHANGE_INPUT resolution class must remain unchanged to preserve exit-code and telemetry behavior across genuine size/format cases and content filter cases
Unit tests must verify the new message for content_filter cases while ensuring non-content_filter CHANGE_INPUT and backward compatibility are unaffected
